d:
Mokama vidhayak anant sinh ki beti shivangi sinh ki shadi ke bad ab unke sasural pahunchne ki charcha ho rahi hai. rishikesh kumar ke sath shadi ke bandhan men bandhin shivangi ki shadi bhi shahi andaj men huee. dulha rishikesh karib 200 gariyon ke kaphile ke sath diphendar men barat lekar pahuncha tha, vahin shivangi ne laind krujar se graind entri li thi.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
